understandsHome: Kwa nini Klar ilitekeleza, kuthibitisha au kusimama
parseHint: Lab is the Assist path for the selected language. Decision and intents here are what Klar runs. Sentence triggers run only if Klar is unreachable.
settingsBackupHint: Overlay, assignments, rules, and the LLM endpoint. Conversations and the house graph stay on this engine.
settingsBackupIncludeKeyHint: Off by default. On: the archive contains the stored LLM key.
settingsBackupIncludeKeyConfirm: The archive will contain the LLM API key. Download anyway?
settingsBackupRestoreConfirm: This overwrites all Klar settings on this engine.
customHint: Unganisha sentensi kwenye nia inayojulikana. Sera ziko kando, si kama otomatiki za Home Assistant.
engineOffline: Engine unreachable. This list is empty until a live load succeeds.
emptyBundle: Bado hakuna rekodi. Washa kifurushi kisha jaribu sentensi.
graphHint: Vyumba kama makundi, vifaa vina rangi kwa imani.
nluRag: Muktadha wa nyumba wakati wa kukosa
nluRagHint: Imezimwa kwa chaguo-msingi. Kipande kilicholingana tu, kamwe zana za Assist.
languageHint: Orodha tupu inaacha kila locale ya Assist iliyokusanywa ikiwashwa. Kubandika pakiti moja ndiyo nyumba ya kawaida.
operatorLanguageHint: Programu hii tu. Imehifadhiwa hapa, au KLAR_UI_LOCALE kabla ya kuhifadhi mara ya kwanza. Si Assist, si wasifu wa Home Assistant.
engineHint: Sauti, lugha na LLM ziko hapa. Home Assistant inaunganisha injini tu.
assistLanguagesHint: Pakiti zipi Klar inaweza kuchambua. Satelaiti bado inatuma lugha moja kwa kila ombi. Tupu = locale zote zilizokusanywa.
voiceHint: Tabia na majibu yanayozungumzwa. Assist inasoma hii kutoka injini, si kutoka chaguo za Home Assistant.
extraPromptHint: Mstari wa hiari juu ya tabia ya pakiti. Acha tupu isipokuwa nyumba inahitaji kanuni yake.
personalityPromptHint: What the engine LLM gets for this voice. Extra prompt below is optional and house-specific.
refineSpeechHint: Klar bado inadhibiti vifaa. LLM ya injini kisha inaandika upya majibu ya NLU yaliyokamilika kwa sauti hii.
quietAckHint: Kwenye taa au swichi rahisi washa/zima, ruka TTS na cheza kengele kwenye satelaiti.
unitSystemHint: Spoken and parsed temperatures. Lights, timers, and brightness stay as they are.
calendarLlmHint: Klar bado inasoma kalenda. Washa: LLM inasema matukio. Zima: Klar inasema orodha.
allowLlmTools: Ruhusu zana za Assist kwenye gumzo
allowLlmToolsHint: Imezimwa kwa chaguo-msingi. Washa: modeli ya gumzo inaweza kudhibiti Home Assistant. Zima: Klar inaruka wakala huyo akiwa na zana.
missHint: Tabaka za hiari baada ya kukataa kwa uhakika. Hakuna inayoweka modeli kwenye parse.
operatorChromeHint: Mandhari na lugha ya kiolesura kwa waendeshaji. Si Assist.
haGlueHint: Home Assistant Configure inahitaji tu URL ya injini, tokeni, kituo na wakala wa mazungumzo uliosalia wa hiari. Sauti na LLM zinabaki hapa.
settingsGuide: Weka hizi tatu, kisha ramani nyumba.
mappingHint: Ramani ni majina mengine ya vipengele vya grafu. Kalenda zinaonekana baada ya eneo la kalenda kujumuishwa. Assist inafuata pakiti ya lugha; uso huu unafuata lugha ya opereta.
nluIgnoreHint: Inaondoa kifaa hiki kwenye kutatua. Tumia kwa visaidizi vilivyopewa jina vibaya.
journalHint: Zamugeuzi 200 za mwisho, saa 24, zimefichwa. Maandishi ghafi tu na kifurushi.
mixCaption: Chanzo: jarida la mazungumzo, zamugeuzi kwa siku
coverageCaption: Chanzo: grafu ya nyumba, sehemu ya vifaa
priority: Mpangilio (sheria ya kwanza ya mtumiaji inayolingana inashinda)
triggerFirst: Klar parse, then that path. Assist does not run a different intent, a sentence trigger, or a weather fallback.
payloadTemplate: Kiolezo cha Home Assistant; {{ text }} ni usemi
payloadLlm: Kidokezo cha mfumo kwa ajenti ya akiba
routineHint: Jina lililonenwa linaanza hati ya Home Assistant. Usiku mwema hushinda salamu.
tryTheseHint: Gusa sentensi ili kuijaribu kwenye maabara.
personalityHa: Sauti, lugha na LLM ziko kwenye ukurasa huu wa Settings.
customVoiceHint: The seed sets the character. Sliders only refine how it speaks. Language lock and safety rules stay.
customVoiceMake: Write voice from seed and sliders
customVoiceFail: Could not write a voice. Check the LLM.
customVoiceNameHint: How this personality appears in the list.
customVoiceSeedHint: Who Klar should be, independent of the sliders. For example: You are Spock from Star Trek.
interviewTraitsHint: 0 = off, 10 = strong. Delivery only, not the character.
lexiconEmpty: Hakuna delta za kifuniko cha kamusi.
governEmpty: Mbegu za usalama huja na kila pakiti. Zima huandika kubatilisha nyumba; sakafu iliyokusanywa inabaki washa.
matchReadOnly: Safu inayokosa hutumia chaguo-msingi la injini. Kifuniko tupu ni orodha ya wagombea leo.
matchDisableWarning: Kuzima area_command au all_lights hubadilisha amri za chumba na nyumba nzima.
trainerHint: Ask about Klar anytime. Writes wait for Allow in this chat.
trainerNeedLlm: Configure an LLM in Settings first. No other Home Assistant conversation agent.
llmHint: Klar inazungumza na sehemu ya mwisho inayolingana na OpenAI. Gumzo la Assist na mkufunzi wanatumia config ile ile. Muunganisho wa OpenAI au Ollama katika Home Assistant hauhitajiki.
llmModelsEmpty: No models from this endpoint. Type an id.
llmModelsFail: Could not list models. Type an id.
llmApiKeyHint: Acha tupu ili kuweka ufunguo uliohifadhiwa. Ollama inaweza kubaki tupu.
llmThinkingHint: Off sends enable_thinking=false (default). Leave off for Gemma 4 so replies stay in the content channel.
conversationsEmptyHint: Say something through Assist. It shows up here.
evaluatorHint: Type it as you would at home. The framed step is the one that fired.
rulesRoutinesHint: A spoken name starts a Home Assistant script.
rulesSentencesHint: One sentence onto a known intent. Then try it.
rulesPoliciesHint: Three lanes. Your house rule wins first. Then try a sentence below.
guideRoutinesSayHint: Good night, I’m leaving, movie time.
guideRoutinesScriptHint: Pick script.xxx. Do not type an entity id.
guideSentencesIntentHint: Pick an intent, optionally a device.
guideSentencesTestHint: Preview before you keep the phrase.
guidePoliciesMatchHint: Engine matchers. Leave on unless you know why.
guidePoliciesLangHint: Pack seeds and lexicon. Only if a word is wrong.
guidePoliciesHouseHint: When → then. Pick a device or room, don’t type ids.
guidePoliciesTestHint: Type a sentence and analyze. The framed lane fired.
houseGuideGraph: Tap a device to inspect. Drag only moves the card.
houseGuideMap: Accept the suggestion or pick a room.
labGuide: Type a sentence, then Analyze or Enter.
trainerEmpty: Ask how Klar works — or about a gap.
trainerEmptyHint: Lotse writes nothing until you tap Allow.
trainerPromptNight: Suggest a house rule for good night.
trainerPromptMatchers: Which matchers are on, and in what order?
trainerPromptPrecedence: Explain matcher precedence. Do not change it.
trainerPromptLexicon: Which lexicon paths exist for German?
trainerPromptSlang: Suggest slang for a lexicon path. Do not write yet.
ragMode: Muktadha wa nyumba wakati wa kukosa
